topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Lecture Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic establishes the lecture framing by introducing cancer evolution, microenvironmental interactions, and key learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer develops through Darwinian selection of fitter mutated clones alongside non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the hierarchical cancer stem cell model and experimental evidence for how specific cells of origin govern tumor initiation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how external stimuli and chronic inflammatory signalling act as promotional cues required for malignant transformation.

topics.label: Established Microenvironments, Spatial Profiling, and Evolutionary Synthesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the dependency of established tumors on their cellular niche and synthesise the multi-factorial coevolution of cancer.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Upcoming Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the session and previews the upcoming lecture on cancer therapy.
